coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using 17 ground-truth items (counting listed dataset, model, SSP, and attack options separately), 7 match: Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, both SSP settings, AutoDAN, lexical ASR evaluation, and averaging ASR over five resamples, although the latter is limited to a robustness subset. Score: 7/17, rounded to 41%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The primary dataset is HarmBench rather than AdvBench and MaliciousInstruct; AdvBench appears only as a fallback. JailTrickBench is missing. Three required models and PAIR are absent, while unrelated models and attacks are added. The AutoDAN suffix-length range of 10–100 tokens and fixed PAIR query budget are unspecified. The HarmBench classifier replaces the required GPT-based evaluator, and repeated-run averaging is not applied to headline results.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that safety system prompts substantially reduce ASRs or reports the model-specific AutoDAN and PAIR reductions. Hypotheses in the design do not constitute an observed conclusion.
